hyp: In December 1952, two young Americans were reported lost on a flight from Korea to Japan.
That was a cover story.
John Downey and Richard Fecto were CIA officers shot down inside China.
Their job that night. Pick up an agent from the snow without landing.
Two poles held a line the plane trails a hook catches the line and winches the man aboard
But the agent team had been caught the radio call was a trap
Under a nearly full moon, the plane came in low and slow.  White sheets flew off two hidden guns.
The plane crashed in the trees. Both pilots died. Downie and Fekto lived.
A Chinese officer looked at Downey and said you are Jack
For 20 years, Washington stuck to its story.
Then President Nixon said it out loud. Downie involves a CIA agent.
Six weeks later, Downie walked across a bridge into Hong Kong, after 7,408 days.
